title: Images
content: Images are a way to display visual content on a webpage. They are added to HTML documents using the `` tag, which links to an image file. Attributes like `src` (source), `alt` (alternative text), `width`, and `height` are used to specify the image's location, description, and dimensions. Visit the following resources to learn more: - [@article@HTML images](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Core/Structuring_content/HTML_images) - [@article@: The Image Embed element](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/img) - [@video@HTML - Images | W3Schools](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FmoYRiepmOE)
